name: Screen Record (Windows)
summary: Record your Windows desktop to an MP4 file. Pick the monitor, set a bitrate, and start.
description: Captures the desktop via Direct3D11 (the GPU-accelerated Windows capture path), encodes with H.264 + AAC, and writes a self-contained MP4. The monitor index variable selects which display to record (0 = primary). Default bitrate is 6 Mbps. Requires Windows 10 or newer for the D3D11 capture element.
